title: Fractal Audio Axe-Fx III

x_pc.additionalInfo: Use MIDI Bank Select CC0 values 0-3 plus PC 0-127 to select Axe-Fx III presets 0-511. Axe-Fx III Mark II extends this map to 1024 presets using CC0 values 0-7.

additionalInfo: Incoming MIDI CCs are globally assignable in SETUP > MIDI/Remote to functions including input and output volumes, tap tempo, tuner, 16 external controllers, scene functions, all looper functions, and all block bypass/channel switches. Scene values select scenes 1-8, repeating every 8 values; channel values select A-D, repeating every 4 values. Axe-Fx III can transmit CC and PC messages, receives MIDI clock, and does not transmit MIDI clock.
